ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: the figure is a schematic map of the China-Russia region, marking the China-Russia crude oil pipeline route connecting an oil source or oil transportation node on the Russian side with the direction of Northeast China, and is accompanied by information such as annual oil transportation volume and contract term. Then reason: the question stem asks "what is the advantage of using pipelines to transport petroleum," which tests the characteristics of the pipeline transportation method. Petroleum can be continuously transported along fixed pipelines, suitable for long-term, uninterrupted transportation of oil and gas, so its prominent advantage is strong continuity.
